environment.description: Same Django REST API on EKS 1.28 in namespace 'api-prod'. A Cilium-managed NetworkPolicy with L3/L4 egress rules is applied. The policy spec uses a CiliumNetworkPolicy CRD with egressDeny rules targeting CIDR 169.254.169.254/32 on TCP port 80, applied via label selector matching app=jwt-api pods. The policy also has a default-allow egress rule for all other traffic to avoid breaking DNS/service communication. Note: the policy does NOT use the standard Kubernetes NetworkPolicy resource - it uses the CiliumNetworkPolicy CRD which has different semantics around rule ordering and deny precedence. The deny rule takes priority over allow rules in Cilium's policy engine regardless of rule specificity.
